info.description: REST API of the Wattson server, which controls a Merach exercise bike. Authenticate with an API token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`) or the session cookie set by the login flow.
info.title: Wattson API

post.description: Verifies a local username and password and sets the session cookie. Attempts are rate limited per remote IP address (the connection's address; X-Forwarded-For is ignored): after 10 failures in 10 minutes every attempt from that address, whatever the username, returns 429 `rate_limited` with a `Retry-After` header in seconds. Unknown user, wrong password, disabled user and password-less (OIDC) users all return the same 401 `invalid_credentials`. Returns 403 `local_login_disabled` when password sign-in is turned off and the user is not the bootstrap admin. No authentication required.
Deletes the current session, if any, and clears the session cookie. No authentication required.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user, the scopes of the credential in use, and whether it is a session or a token. Requires the `read` scope.

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password. Session only: an API token gets 403 `session_required`. A wrong current password returns 400 `invalid_current_password`. All of the user's sessions are deleted and a fresh session cookie is set. Requires the `read` scope.

get.description: Lists the ways to sign in: whether setup is pending, whether password sign-in is enabled, and the OIDC provider buttons. No authentication required.

Returns the whole configuration. Secrets are write-only: each is reported as a `*_set` boolean (`bike.esphome_key_set`, `ha.token_set`, `mqtt.password_set`, `mapillary.token_set`, `strava.client_secret_set`) and the value is never returned. Requires the `admin` scope.

patch.description: Changes the fields present in the body and leaves the rest alone. Secret fields are write-only: omit one to keep the stored value, send an empty string to clear it, or send a value to replace it. The merged result is validated as a whole; a bad value returns 400 `invalid_setting` with the message `<section.field>: <problem>` and nothing is stored. Returns the new settings in the same shape as the GET. Requires the `admin` scope.

post.description: Connects to the ESPHome device, performs the encrypted handshake and reads its device info, then disconnects, timing out after 5 seconds. It never subscribes to Bluetooth and never talks to the bike, so it is safe during a ride. Empty body fields fall back to the stored settings. The result is always HTTP 200; check `ok`. A device without the Bluetooth proxy component reports `no bluetooth_proxy`. Requires the `admin` scope.

Calls `GET {url}/api/` with the token as a bearer credential, timing out after 5 seconds. Empty body fields fall back to the stored settings. The result is always HTTP 200; check `ok`. A 401 from Home Assistant reports `token rejected (401)`. Requires the `admin` scope.

Creates the bootstrap admin, optionally saves the public URL, and signs the new admin in with a session cookie. If saving the public URL fails after the admin was created, the failure is logged and the admin is still created. Fails with 409 `already_setup` once any user exists. No authentication required.

schema.description: Session cookie for the new admin.

get.description: Reports whether first-run setup is still needed. No authentication required.
Returns the caller's own API tokens, without their secrets. Requires the `read` scope.

post.description: Creates a token for the signed-in user and returns its plaintext exactly once. Session only: an API token gets 403 `session_required`. The scopes must be held by the caller, otherwise 403 `scope_exceeds`. Requires the `read` scope.

delete.description: Deletes one of the caller's own tokens. Revocation takes effect immediately. A token owned by someone else returns 404. Requires the `read` scope.

get.description: Returns every user account, ordered by ID. Requires the `admin` scope.

patch.description: Changes a user's admin or disabled flag. Disabling a user deletes all of that user's sessions. The bootstrap admin cannot be demoted or disabled (409 `bootstrap_protected`), and the last enabled admin cannot be removed (409 `last_admin`). Requires the `admin` scope.

get.description: Returns 200 while the server is running. No authentication required.
